name: JG_FSCL_TAX_AUTH_RET_INT
description: This interface table contains tax authority returned information related to multiple fiscal document events. Fiscal document events represent the requests made to the tax authority, like Fiscal Document Status, Cancellation, Void and Contingency. Tax authority response is captured in this table along with other relevant fiscal document information.

columns.name: TAX_AUTHORITY_RETURN_ID
columns.description: Interface identifier of the tax authority event return.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_KEY
columns.description: Fiscal document access key composed by concatenation of fiscal document number and other fiscal document information. It is used as unique identifier for the tax authority system.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_EVENT_CODE
columns.description: Fiscal document event code representing the request that is being made to the tax authority. Possible values are Fiscal Document Status, Cancellation, Void and Contingency.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the set of records to be processed.

columns.name: TAX_AUTH_RETURN_CODE
columns.description: Internal code representing the return code from tax authority. Standard tax authority return codes will be transformed into this internal code. The return code is dependent on the request made to tax authority. Possible values are Approved, Cancelled, Contingency approved, Contingency rejected, Errors, Pending return, Rejected, Sent, Upload failed and Void.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the record has already being processed by fiscal document import process.

columns.name: PROCESSED_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Date and time when a fiscal document was processed by the tax authority.

columns.name: PROTOCOL_NUMBER
columns.description: Number generated by the tax authority to uniquely identify the transactions of authorization, cancelation, and void related to a fiscal document.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_DATE
columns.description: Date when fiscal document is issued by city tax authority.

columns.name: DOC_NUM
columns.description: Unique number that is assigned to a document, such as fiscal document number or tax invoice number.

columns.name: SRVC_INVOICE_VERIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Verification code of the fiscal document for a service invoice.

columns.name: TAX_AUTH_DOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Certificate number provided by the muncipality on payment of taxes.

columns.name: TAX_SETTLEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of certificate provided by the muncipality on the payment of taxes.
